description: Full IP intelligence for an IPv4 or IPv6 address — geolocation (country, city, state, postal code, lat/long, timezone, local time), ISP/ASN/org, and security risk flags (VPN, proxy, Tor, datacenter, mobile + a 0-100 risk score). Keyless.

ip.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up, e.g. "8.8.8.8" or "2606:4700:4700::1111".

name: lookup_ip
title: Lookup Ip
